name: test-genie.run-evidence
purpose: Read bounded Test Genie run evidence or stream one catalog-selected artifact into the admitted workspace through the trusted Program Runtime file effect.

path.description: Relative file path inside the already-admitted Program Runtime workspace; required for download.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing destination only when explicitly true.

assumptions: Scenario and run IDs are exact owner-issued identities; artifact_id is copied from this run's typed catalog.
Download requires an active test-genie.run-evidence execution with an admitted workspace and the required Test Genie read grant.

The host bridge re-resolves the exact artifact identity/path, enforces declared size and the 64 MiB cap, streams to a same-directory temporary file, and atomically publishes without clobber unless overwrite=true.
The receiver computes SHA-256; Test Genie publishes no source digest, so the receipt hash is not source-cross-verified.
invariants: Never guess an artifact ID or construct an owner/private endpoint.
Before download, read the exact scenario/run/artifact metadata and require matching ID, a non-negative declared size within 64 MiB, and stream capability.
Download writes bytes only through program.write_artifact into the admitted workspace; bytes never pass through Python output or JSON.
Destination is relative and traversal-free; overwrite defaults false and remains explicit.
Return only exact identity, kind, relative path, declared/received byte count, receiver SHA-256, and legacy-discovery metadata; omit owner access paths and arbitrary metadata.
If the stream effect does not return a verifiable receipt, report effect_uncertain and do not retry automatically.

signals.result: bounded owner response; artifact views are explicitly projected and omit access paths
signals.metadata: catalog count, truncation, and legacy-discovery status
signals.receipt: download only: {scenario,run_id,artifact_id,kind,output_path,bytes,sha256,legacy_discovered,source_digest_verified:false}; no bytes or source path
signals.source_digest_verified: receipt field, always false because the owner catalog supplies no expected SHA-256
